name: cc-enslaver
description: A Claude Code plugin and LLM-agnostic rule pack that enforces systematic thinking, verified citations, and root-cause analysis — eliminating reactive, lazy AI behavior. v0.22 adds two write-time content detectors as rules 10 and 11. rule 10 (no non-essential hardcoding) denies an Edit/Write whose code inlines a credential: a secret-named identifier assigned a quoted literal, a PEM private-key header, an AWS access-key literal, or credentials embedded in a connection URL. rule 11 (no non-essential path dependency) denies code that bakes in a machine-specific user-home absolute path or a shell home variable, which breaks portability. Both mirror the rule-09 PreToolUse content-detector mechanism, share its adjacent why-comment escape hatch (how 'non-essential' is operationalized), exempt prose-doc and lockfile targets, and add no Stop layer. v0.22.1 sharpens two existing rules from field failures, adding no new detector or Stop layer: rule 06 gains Check 2b (aggregate-equal is not unchanged — compare item sets, not totals; and a green gate proves nothing about the parts it does not check), and rule 09 gains a bulk-mechanical-edit discipline (survey the token's real neighbourhoods, rewrite only allowlisted forms, emit a refusal report, reconcile the arithmetic, never rewrite a path handed to a fixed git rev, enumerate a closed set instead of blacklisting stray shapes). v0.22.2 adds a version-drift gate (tests/test_version_sync.py): plugin.json is the single version authority, every version-bearing pointer in the manifests is a registered closed set compared against it, and the README badge plus the newest CHANGELOG release heading are pinned too. It exists because v0.22.1 shipped with marketplace.json — the file the plugin installer reads — still naming the previous version, so the release was invisible to users while every test stayed green. English remains the i18n skeleton and source of truth (rules/ + prompts/ at the root, default injection); Chinese is a first-class translation (rules/zh/ + prompts/zh/, via CC_ENSLAVER_LANG=zh), with drift CI-blocked by i18n_check.py + test_i18n_sync.py.
